name: Brave Moonhorn
summary: At the Barrens' southern border, Brave Moonhorn watches the Great Lift into Thousand Needles. From its heights, he warns travelers of dangers ahead.

sections.title: Sentinel of the Lift
sections.body: Brave Moonhorn guards the boundary between the northern plains and the canyonlands. From above Thousand Needles, he watches the canyon floor for threats, especially hostile centaur clans. Travelers often meet him before descending into the needles. He warns them of danger before they step onto the Great Lift's massive platforms.

sections.title: Uneasy Shadows
sections.body: Brave Moonhorn distrusts the Grimtotem tauren. He tells traveling Horde allies to keep their distance because the tribe acts erratically and suspiciously around Thousand Needles. To help defend the region, he sends couriers to Freewind Post with warnings for Cliffwatcher Longhorn.

faq.answer: Brave Moonhorn is a tauren warrior and scout watching the approach to the Great Lift between the Barrens and Thousand Needles. He watches for enemy activity and warns passing travelers of nearby hazards.

faq.q: Why does Moonhorn warn against the Grimtotem?
faq.answer: Moonhorn warns against the Grimtotem because they act strangely and unpredictably in the surrounding canyon. Though part of the tauren community, their aggressive insularity makes them untrustworthy to guards keeping order along the trail.

faq.q: What message does he want delivered to Freewind Post?
faq.answer: Moonhorn wants word carried about rising centaur activity in Thousand Needles. He asks dependable Horde runners to deliver the warning to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.
Brave Moonhorn stands near the plateau's edge at the top of the Great Lift, on the boundary between the Barrens and Thousand Needles.

angles.text: Moonhorn guides new Horde arrivals in the canyon toward safety and the fortified heights of Freewind Post.
As a tauren, you may recognize Moonhorn's wariness of the Grimtotem as part of the distrust between Cairne Bloodhoof's traditional tribes and the secretive Grimtotem.
